summary: Cowen expects large gains from AI, argues that institutions absorb it slowly and asks AI pessimists for testable predictions.

statements.quote: There are further AI/Intelligence advances on tap, plus absorbing the advances to date, and exploiting them, takes a long time.
If you have very pessimistic fears or predictions about AI, name the market prices that will support or confirm them.
The key is to create some basic safeguards, but without stifling broader AI progress.
statements.venue: Marginal Revolution, excerpt of his Free Press column

statements.quote: I think the net picture of strong AI is likely to be good rather than bad.
statements.venue: Talk at Google DeepMind, Human Life in a Post-AGI World

statements.quote: The biggest risk is not from the AI companies, but rather that the government with the most powerful AI systems becomes the bad guy itself.
statements.venue: Marginal Revolution, excerpt of his Free Press column
